Summary Description: Dr. John N. Jiang specializes in data-driven analysis of power systems under high inverter-based resource penetration. He co-develops and applies methods like Sparse Identification of Nonlinear Dynamics (SINDy) and HAVOK, often augmented with Volterra-based nonlinearity metrics and time-delay embeddings, to identify and interpret nonlinear energy-flow dynamics on IEEE 15-bus test networks. His work emphasizes interpretable, scalable models that distinguish SG-dominated, SG+IBR, and IBR-dominated regimes, enabling improved grid operation, planning, and measurement-based state understanding in modern grids.
